'''Dorv'Tilsta''', or '''Dorv Tilsta''', was a young [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Lethan/Legends|Lethan]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiate]] who was brought into the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]], Dorv Tilsta was five standard years old when wandering [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Vhiin Thorla]] discovered they young boy's proclivity to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Explaining his mission to end slavery of their shared race, Master Thorla convinced the boy's parents to allow young Tilsta to enter into the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] as his personal [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]]. Taking Tilsta under his wing, Master Thorla took the young apprentice to [[The Enclave]], a refuge built for former slaves, and studiously began his [[Jedi training/Legends|studies]] in the ways of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. Throughout his first days at The Enclave, Tilsta met many of its residents, including other Twi'lek children, namely [[Tror]], [[Dath]], and [[Meeva]]. It was within this time that a group of slavers discovered and attacked The Enclave. During the ensuing fight, Tilsta disobeyed his Master's orders to stay hidden, and attempted to help the Enclave's defenders. In the fighting, Tilsta was captured and stunned by an attacking slaver, but in the end was rescued by two Jedi agents who were at the Enclave meeting with Master Thorla.<ref name="TS" />

Not long after, the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] erupted between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], though Tilsta and his master remained out of the conflict. To this end, the occupants of the Enclave were not uncovered at the end of the war when the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] rose to power and the Jedi Order was disbanded. As the Empire initiated the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]] and Jedi across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] were hunted down and destroyed, Tilsta and his master remained secluded on Ryloth without contact from any of their peers in the Order. After two long years of isolation, the pair set out to look for survivors, heading for the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] and the [[Almas Academy|Order's academy]] on [[Almas]]. Touching down on the planet, the Jedi pair were shocked to find the academy a smoldering ruin, leveled after an attack two years prior. While probing through the debris, their presence was discovered by [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] [[Valin Draco]] and his [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] apprentice, [[Raik Muun]]. Muun used a [[t'salak]] beast to overwhelm the ten year old Tilsta's senses, throwing him into an uncontrolled rage. A slave to the t'salak's [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] influence, Tilsta began to attack his own master. Although Master Thorla did not want to fight against his own Padawan, Draco promised that he would turn the young Twi'lek to the dark side if he refused to fight. Believing that he had no other choice, Thorla reluctantly struck down his own apprentice, killing him.<ref name="EOTJ" />
